author: fwyzard
body:
#### PR description:

Extend `cudaComputeCapabilities` to print device UUIDs.

For NVIDIA GPUs, use NVML to resolve GPU UUIDs (_e.g._ `GPU-b803e676-f4b3-4bc2-d08e-05cefd5812ae`) and MIG UUIDs (_e.g._ `MIG-1f292bf8-f63f-570f-a866-efaab3ceb50a`).

#### PR validation:

None.
title: Add flag to print GPU UUIDs
